Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1172
Claimant:
Kyle Hahn
Adjuster:
Darin Tyler
May 30, 2025
First notice of loss received on the rear-end collision involving the insured vehicle. The claimant reports a concussion
and is now represented by counsel, so all further contact will go through the attorney's office.
June 10, 2025
Reviewed the police report and spoke with two independent witnesses, who both describe the other vehicle stopping
abruptly and being struck from behind. Photos from the scene line up with that account.
August 6, 2025
Inspected the damaged vehicle. The rear bumper, trunk lid and tail lamp assembly show crush and impact patterns
consistent with the reported speed and direction of the collision.
August 11, 2025
Confirmed with the police and both witnesses that the claimant was seated in the vehicle at the time of impact. The
driver is named on the policy and coverage was in force on the loss date.
October 4, 2025
Ran a prior-claims search and found no earlier damage recorded on this vehicle. Records show no earlier injury
claims involving the same body area for the claimant.
October 6, 2025
Spoke with the claimant's attorney, who provided the medical summary. The concussion diagnosis and the symptoms
described fit the force of a collision of this type.
October 10, 2025
Reviewed treatment records. Care followed a typical course of rest, follow-up visits and gradual reduction in
frequency as symptoms improved, with discharge noted after recovery.
October 24, 2025
Took a recorded statement from the claimant through counsel. The account of the collision matches what was told to
the police, the other driver and the witnesses, and has stayed the same in every conversation.
November 27, 2025
Reviewed all information gathered to date. Damage, injury and the accident account are consistent with one another,
and nothing points to a pre-existing condition or prior damage. File remains open pending final medical bills.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
